extracted.subtask_description: A multi-unit, leveled online Korean course providing vocabulary, grammar, audio, practice exercises, and supplemental materials from learning to read through near-expert grammar.

rubrics_metrics.name: Site purpose and quality promise
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Korean learners with a one-stop resource; offer the most detailed, accurate and clear explanations at every step of the way.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lessons will always be free and are 'chuck-full' of content; the site aims to cover learning how to read up to advanced grammar.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lesson vocabulary quantity
rubrics_metrics.description: Each lesson includes twenty to thirty vocabulary words.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as the base lexical content for each lesson; implies scope of new terms introduced per lesson.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grammar tailored to level
rubrics_metrics.description: Grammar content in each lesson is tailored to the specific level of study and applies the vocabulary from that lesson.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grammar points are selected to fit learner level and to reinforce lesson vocabulary through applied examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audio coverage for lesson content
rubrics_metrics.description: Audio recordings of every Korean word and sentence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides pronunciation support; audio is included as a base component of each lesson to accompany vocabulary and grammar.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unit structure and progression
rubrics_metrics.description: Lessons are organized into Units; each Unit contains 25 Lessons, 3 Quizzes and a Unit Test.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Units are labeled from Unit 0 (Learning How to Read) through Unit 8 (Near-Expert Korean Grammar), indicating a staged progression from literacy to near-expert grammar.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workbooks per lesson
rubrics_metrics.description: Workbooks for each lesson where learners can apply what they learn to interesting and useful exercises.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supplemental practice exercises focused on applying vocabulary and grammar from the lesson.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mobile app quizzing
rubrics_metrics.description: Mobile App with various ways to quiz yourself on the vocabulary and sentences introduced.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides on-the-go review and spaced practice in app form; complements web lessons with interactive quiz formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional audio files
rubrics_metrics.description: Audio files for every word and sentence in Korean (listed again among supplemental material).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reinforces that full audio corpus is available as standalone files in addition to in-lesson audio.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hanja lessons
rubrics_metrics.description: Hanja Lessons to help you understand the root-meanings of words.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides etymological/root-meaning insight useful for vocabulary building and deeper comprehension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Short stories for reading practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Short Stories to increase your reading skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authentic or graded reading material to build comprehension and fluency beyond sentence-level practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simple vocabulary lists
rubrics_metrics.description: Simple Lists of vocabulary in case you want to organize things your way.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Raw lists for personal organization or custom study; supports learner-directed review and sorting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anki packages
rubrics_metrics.description: Anki Packages so you can make digital practice cards at home.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pre-built spaced-repetition flashcard decks for SRS study using the lesson vocabulary and sentences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vocabulary usage lists
rubrics_metrics.description: Vocabulary Lists to help you understand how each word can be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists that include usage/context guidance (not just wordform lists) to aid practical application of vocabulary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conjugation tool
rubrics_metrics.description: Conjugate buttons that you can press to see how every verb and adjective is conjugated (completed to Lesson 75).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interactive conjugation feature to view paradigm forms for verbs and adjectives up to the stated lesson completion point.

rubrics_metrics.name: Word search exercises
rubrics_metrics.description: Word Searches to help you train your brain to recognize words in Korean.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gamified recognition practice to reinforce orthographic and lexical recognition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Print and ebook availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Paperback and Kindle versions of the lessons are available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offers offline and portable reading/study formats in addition to the website and app.

rubrics_metrics.name: Theme-specific lessons
rubrics_metrics.description: Theme Lessons dedicated to a specific subject.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Topical modules focused on particular domains or scenarios to teach domain-specific vocabulary and grammar.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social and community channels
rubrics_metrics.description: Presence on social platforms: YouTube, Patreon, Facebook, Twitter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Channels for supplemental content, community engagement, and potential support/funding avenues.
